title: Best Damn App Reviews Scraper output

results.title: Reviews
results.description: One record per review with store, app, rating, title, text, author display name, version, date, helpful votes and developer reply. Apps that failed are recorded with success=false.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counts of apps requested, reviews fetched and charged, failures, plus per-app metadata (name, developer, average rating, rating count).
